published: President of China XI Jinping (since 14 March 2013)
process: president indirectly elected by National People's Congress for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term); chief executive indirectly elected by the Election Committee and appointed by the PRC Government for a 5-year term (eligible for a second term)
results: 2022: John LEE was the only candidate and won with over 99% of the vote by the Election Committee; 2017: Carrie LAM elected; Election Committee vote - Carrie LAM (non-partisan) 777, John TSANG (non-partisan) 365, WOO Kwok-hing (non-partisan) 21, 23 ballots rejected (1,186 votes cast)
governmentType: presidential limited democracy; a special administrative region of the People's Republic of China
cabinet: Executive Council or ExCo appointed by the chief executive
